11-Day Turkey Discovery Tour: Istanbul to Cappadocia
summary:
The 11-Day Tour of Turkey Wonders follows a rewarding route through several distinct chapters of Turkey’s past. Begin among Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine landmarks, then travel to the Gallipoli battlefields and the legendary site of Troy before continuing through Pergamon and Ephesus. From Pamukkale’s white travertine terraces and ancient Hierapolis, the journey turns inland to Cappadocia, known for its valleys, fairy chimneys and rock-cut settlements.
Operating year-round, the tour offers flexibility around your preferred travel dates. We arrange selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers and all scheduled sightseeing included in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Gallipoli Tour & Transfer to Canakkale
itinerary.text: At 06:30, depart for Eceabat. After lunch, begin the guided Gallipoli campaign Battlefields Tour, visiting Anzac Cove, Lone Pine Memorial, Johnston’s Jolly, The Nek, and Chunuk Bair. After the tour, cross by ferry to Canakkale and check in to your hotel. Overnight in Canakkale.

itinerary.title: Troy & Pergamon Tour – Kusadasi
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:45, visit the ancient city of Troy, famous for the legendary Trojan Horse and its rich history dating back to 3500 BC. Continue to Pergamon for lunch and a guided tour of the Acropolis, including the steepest ancient theatre and the Temple of Trajan. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale & Hierapolis day Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ephesus Tour & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text:
After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, including the Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the Temple of Artemis and the House of the Virgin Mary.
After the tour, transfer to İzmir Airport for your evening flight to Kayseri at 20:30.
Upon arrival at 22:00, transfer to your hotel in Cappadocia. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia, visiting Uchisar Castle, Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum. Continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit Urgup and Avanos, famous for traditional pottery. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soganlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. Overnight in Cappadocia

itinerary.title: Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, and transfer to the airport for your flight to Istanbul.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Half day morning Bosphorus Cruise
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia on one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, return to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 11 Day Tour of Turkey Wonders?
faqs.a: The 11 Day Tour of Turkey Wonders covers Istanbul, Gallipoli, Troy, Pergamon, Pamukkale, Ephesus, and Cappadocia. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, visit the battlefields of Gallipoli, discover the legendary city of Troy, tour the ancient Acropolis of Pergamon, experience Pamukkale's white travertine terraces, walk through the ruins of Ephesus, and explore the unique landscapes of Cappadocia. The tour runs for 10 nights and 11 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 11 Day Tour of Turkey Wonders cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,775 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, three domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this 11-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes three domestic flights. These flights help reduce travel time between destinations and allow you to comfortably explore Turkey's most important historical, cultural, and natural attractions.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 10 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are selected for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the tour are included.

faqs.q: Does the 11 Day Tour of Turkey Wonders include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural background, and local expertise throughout your journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is one of the most comprehensive options for first-time visitors. It combines Turkey's most significant historical sites, archaeological treasures, World War I landmarks, and natural wonders, providing an excellent introduction to the country's rich heritage.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, valleys, and areas with uneven terrain. Locations such as Troy, Pergamon, Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia involve moderate walking, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is not included in the standard package but can be arranged as an optional activity. Since balloon flights are weather-dependent and highly popular, advance reservations are strongly recommended.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 11 Day Tour of Turkey Wonders?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 11 Day Tour of Turkey Wonders available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
